findings.title: CLAUDE.md's 'Programs: one live' still names this program as live
findings.recommendation: Once this closing review lands, rewrite the section the way update-gh-documentation's close was recorded: no program live, this one complete (architect-first, CLI says orbit, docs refined, v2.0.1 released 2026-10-16), its doc linked under Source of truth as complete. commentary: First architecture review for this doc. Ran all six passes over the doc with `orbit architecture status --json` beside it. The premise, rulings and goals trace cleanly to the four stages: R-rda-2's surface list is architect-first's charter, R-rda-3's protections are cli-says-orbit's scope, and G1–G4 each land as a stage's exit, every one observed and ratified. The Depends-on graph (two roots, docs-refinement on both, release on all three) matches the status log's sequencing and has no cycle. Layer-fit holds: rulings stay arc-level, and test and mutation detail sits in the Shipped-as paragraphs, where CLAUDE.md says stage narrative lives. Each Shipped-as is a record true at its archive (release's 'the tag still to cut', docs-refinement's 'Task 5.1 ... was deferred'), and the status log carries what happened after, which is the pattern the program kept throughout. The doc's read cost is modest: `orbit architecture show` slices a stage and the engine renders position, so no state line duplicates it.
